name: Soldier
description: A disciplined fighter trained in warfare, tactics, and battlefield survival.

name: Priest
description: A spiritual guide versed in healing, rituals, and the mysteries of faith.

name: Noble
description: An aristocrat skilled in courtly manners, intrigue, and political influence.

name: Farmer
description: A hardworking cultivator of the land, adept at trade and community knowledge.

name: Hunter
description: A skilled tracker who thrives in the wild, blending patience and precision.

name: Stage Magician
description: An entertainer who dazzles crowds with illusions, tricks, and arcane flair.

name: Bandit
description: A ruthless outlaw who relies on ambush, intimidation, and criminal cunning.
